description: Base Renovate preset for @unabandoned forks: keep dependencies current, soak new releases before adopting them, automerge once green, pin the supply chain, flag anything that itself becomes abandoned, and fast-track security fixes.

packageRules.description: Suppress abandonment flags only for abandoned zero-dependency leaf clones we neither ship to consumers nor plan to fork or vendor - pure dashboard noise, nothing to act on. Anything abandoned that ships in a published @unabandoned tree (e.g. ret) or that we vendor or intend to fork stays flagged, because that is an actionable signal we do not want to hide.
